<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />141 - Ticket validation template added to location</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="141">

This informational message is written whenever a template is added to a location via the location editor.

- Message Text: Ticket validation template added to location
- Data 5 Usage: Template Name
- Message Class: Information
- Message Priority: 5

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="142">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />142 - Ticket validation template removed from location</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="142">

This informational message is written whenever a template is removed from a location via the location editor.

- Message Text: Ticket validation template removed from location
- Data 5 Usage: Template Name
- Message Class: Information
- Message Priority: 5

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="501">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />501 - Failed to send location analysis to designated quality source</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="501">

When the location rollup service is unable to transfer a location’s analysis to a source, as configured in the “Send To” section of a source assignment, it will postpone the rollup queue entry and write this message. A typical cause for this failure is a locked source due to an in-progress user edit. Re-queuing the postponed entry will often solve the problem.

- Message Text: Failed to send location analysis to designated quality source
- Data 1 Usage: Source Number
- Data 2 Usage: Queue Entry Start Date
- Data 3 Usage: Queue Entry End Date
- Message Class: Error
- Message Priority: 5

</div>

</div>
